note: Fight report: Donchenko beat Soriano by unanimous decision at UFC Paris, now 4-0 in the UFC. Embedded UFC tweets and his earlier wins are background; nobody speaks.

Commentator Jon Anik says the UFC is having internal conversations about a Gaethje-Topuria rematch; the second half is Gaethje's own news (McGregor wish, hand injury, retirement talk). Centrality: could be main_subject since the peg is what is next for Topuria. Firmness: a named commentator relays it, but what he relays is 'internal conversations', i.e. talks.
Sport.ua round-by-round report of Donchenko's UD win over Soriano in Paris, wrapped in site navigation and unrelated headlines that are not the article's content.
Same Sport.ua fight report as 759 (UD win over Soriano, 30-27, 30-27, 29-28), with page furniture around it.

Manager Malki Kawa replies to Abdelaziz's boast that Usman Nurmagomedov would beat Topuria: Topuria had a bad night, is still No. 1, will show a masterclass on return. Opinion only. Health: the writer's one line that he has taken time off to heal from facial injuries reads as background, not the news.

Feature on Topuria's Alicante roots (Climent gym, dropping studies, security-guard and cashier jobs) with his quotes about the city and himself; the lead says he is in recovery and his physical trainer says he could be physically ready by year end, the entourage prefers early next year. If the lead's timeline is taken as the main news, fact is next_fight, firmness reported, source his_team. Next fight: only a vague readiness timeline. Health: 'in recovery phase' is one line with no detail, so no. Contains a stale paragraph dating the Gaethje fight in the future.

Gaethje (Sports Illustrated interview) says Topuria did not earn an immediate rematch but the UFC has the last word; he will not fight until 2027 and expects Topuria to sit out too. Act could be assesses_him. The writer adds that Topuria is recovering from nose and orbital fractures and is not expected back before early 2027, which a reader could count as next_fight (timeline) or health; I read both as the outlet's framing around Gaethje's opinion. His Instagram statement is mentioned, not quoted.

Joe Rogan urges Topuria not to rush back, citing Volkanovski; the article relays Topuria's website essay revealing two broken orbitals, a shattered septum and a broken foot. Fact: the headline is Rogan's opinion, so no_fact is defensible; I took the injury revelation as the news. He speaks: the essay is paraphrased, no direct quote of his appears.

Donchenko tells NV what he said to his grandmother, who opposed his MMA career, after his TKO win: he can earn good money, does not drink or use drugs. The article also states he fights Soriano in Paris on 5 September. Result: the lead recounts the TKO win as the peg for the call, not as the news, so no.
Clean copy of the Sport.ua fight report: Donchenko dominated Soriano and won by unanimous decision, fourth UFC win.

Two halves: Topuria (1Win video) says he no longer bases happiness on goals and lives in the present; Dana White says Topuria is ready to fight and both Gaethje and Pimblett would be good, with an unconfirmed rumour of Pimblett in December. Source could be promotion, fact no_fact if the mindset quote is taken as the story; I took White's 'ready to fight' as the news, hence official_or_done, though the Pimblett date is rumour.

Topuria's own words (letter to his son, Marca interview) on his childhood: parents emigrating, six years apart, family reunion in Alicante, the promise to build a better life. The Gaethje defeat is only the frame.
Topuria recalls being bullied at school in Georgia with his brother Aleksandre, feeling fear, and learning to ask for help. One direct quote; the rest paraphrases him.

MMA Junkie staff picks for UFC Paris; Donchenko appears once, in the readers' pick line 'Donchenko (71%)'. Source: the pick line is readers (fans), the article is the outlet's staff picks (media). Act: a pick percentage is a prediction of his fight, but so thin that none_of_these would also fit. His opponent is never named.

Dana White on Gaethje's possible retirement and money left to make; on Topuria he says the big talk is whether he fights Gaethje or Pimblett, and the writer says Topuria is ready to fight. Act/firmness: White states that the choice is open, not a booking, so I read it as the promotion voicing plans (rumour) rather than an official fact; next_fight yes rests on that same open choice.

Fans on X blast (and some back) a possible immediate Gaethje rematch after Jon Anik said the UFC held internal conversations about it; many say Topuria should fight a contender first. Source could be media (Anik's leak is the underlying news). A snippet of Topuria's website statement is quoted.

Gaethje's manager Abdelaziz says Gaethje is not retiring, returns in 2027 and wants a massive fight (Holloway, Oliveira/Tsarukyan winner); Topuria is only the man he beat. Centrality: the fight already fought is the peg, so one_of_several is arguable, but Topuria gets no content of his own. Act none_of_these: nobody says or does anything regarding Topuria; the closest would be gives_news_of_him about Gaethje, not him.

Physical trainer Jesus Gallo: recovery from the orbital and septum fractures is going very well, physically he could be ready by December but waiting for spring 2027 is the smart choice; CSAC 180-day suspension noted. Fact could be health rather than the return timeline the headline leads with.

Merab Dvalishvili, described as his UFC teammate and friend, says Topuria is fine, positive, enjoying life and will come back to reclaim the belt; the piece also re-quotes Topuria's post-fight social media message and Gaethje ruling out a rematch. 'He is fine' is a thin health update: act could be assesses_him, fact no_fact, health no. Rematch talk is wish and opinion only.

Dana White denies a conspiracy theory that the military altered the weather for UFC White House; Topuria appears once as the man Gaethje upset. Act none_of_these: nobody does anything regarding him; source is answered for the main content (White).
